boundaries.name: hashOpaque
boundaries.obligation: Leaf hashing is an opaque Poseidon callback; no injectivity between distinct leaf types is assumed.

boundaries.name: leafInnerNodeSeparation
boundaries.obligation: For PoseidonHashOut leaves, hash is the identity; whatever prevents a leaf from being read as an inner node is the tree gadget's structural discipline, not this file.
